author: David Beards
text: If nothing else works and it keeps doing it, uninstall and reinstall the app. You won’t have any history in the app but it is all online so you won’t lose anything. That was the fix given to me by abbotts.

author: Steven Fadrowski
text: Usually the Wi-Fi thing disconnect your Wi-Fi and then pull your Bluetooth on it and then just turn it off and turn it back on and then reopen the thing for it. It should be fine working again. It just gets out of sink once in a while. if it’s still giving you problems after that, just reset the phone.
